name: condtrig
description: Conditional trigs: Chance FX values above 100 are conditions on how many times the pattern has played (1st, !1s, 1:2 ... 8:8), counted per track from playback or pattern start

branches.note: app_audio_block: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600aa858); first the counts back to 0 when playback has just started
render loop: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600bc2d8); the same, so renders count from 0 too
seq_change_selection_fx_value (encoder edit): bl fx_max (veneer 0x600af2c8); Chance goes up to 137 (8:8)
pattern grid rows: bl fx_value_text_cell 0x600afdc8 for FX1; a condition's name instead of its number
pattern grid rows: bl fx_value_text_cell 0x600afdc8 for FX2; a condition's name instead of its number

itcm_branches.note: seq_process_track, Chance FX: bl rand_range_q 0x3af4 -> mt_ct_chance(lo, hi, column record, track): conditions 101..137
seq_tick, end of a count-in: bl seq_play_from 0x1250 -> mt_ct_count_in (counts back to 0)

words.note: ITCM image (copied to ITCM 0x1f81c at boot): the word seq_tick's veneer jumps through to seq_advance_step 0x600ad011 -> mt_ct_advance_step (counts a track's passes)
flash veneer 0x600ac600 to seq_play_from 0x1251 -> mt_ct_play_from_a (counts back to 0)
